description: Confirm a reservation made with reserve_slot. Present the returned stored booking_details to the customer and relay only the customer-supplied 6-digit code received at their email or phone; never generate, guess, or fetch it. For an active configured calendar, a verified code attempts a direct commit to the selected calendar with no owner approval. booking_pending means the provider outcome is uncertain; repeat confirm_booking later to check the stored outcome, but it never retries a provider write automatically. A paid booking (reserve_slot returned payment.required = true) has no code: this answers payment_required — pay it with create_booking_payment_link — or payment_in_flight while its payment is settling.

code.description: The customer-supplied 6-digit confirmation code received at their own email or SMS contact. Relay only that supplied code; never generate, guess, or fetch it.

reservation_id.description: The reservation id returned by reserve_slot

name: confirm_booking

message.description: Optional customer-facing status detail to relay

status.description: 'confirmed': a booking was committed to the selected configured calendar, or a historical legacy reservation was confirmed. 'booking_pending': the provider outcome is unresolved; do not create another booking or seek owner approval — repeat confirm_booking later to read the stored outcome. 'pending_merchant': a historical merchant-review reservation awaits a business decision — see message. 'already_confirmed': this reservation was confirmed earlier (safe replay).

title: Confirm Booking
